realtime_memories.content: portfolio-website (Vite + React) is for "Tanisha Brahma" (SOC / detection engineering / applied cryptography). GitHub repo: github.com/Junecoderr/portfolio-website (public, origin/main), gh CLI authenticated as myselfRaifMondal.

Two Claude Design projects referenced across sessions: an earlier one titled "Security Portfolio" (claude.ai/design/p/b8c599c9-0a8b-4d67-a6c0-f3ed0929dbd8) from 2026-08-13, and "Tanisha Brahma - Portfolio" (project fb82127e-3d38-4094-a6ff-d8e7809dbd8) from 2026-08-17, which is the one actually implemented (read via DesignSync) as the current 5-route SPA (home/work/case/about/contact, React state, no router).

Stack: three.js only (gsap dropped — scroll-reveal is plain IntersectionObserver). LatticeScene.jsx is a config-driven WebGL glass-node background, position:fixed (must stay fixed, not absolute, or it stretches to full page scroll height). Kept a percent-gate Preloader (4-piece spinner) as a deliberate addition on top of the imported design, themed to its blue/violet/magenta palette.

IP boundary: when a design reference is a real third-party commercial site (e.g. noomo agency showcase), match the interaction mechanic with original assets only — never copy their licensed fonts/SVGs/code verbatim. The user's own Claude Design projects are their own content and are fine to implement in full.

No OPENROUTER_API_KEY configured on this machine — real image generation (generate-image skill) unavailable. Repo convention is labeled placeholder panels until a key is provided. A tanisha.png was manually dropped in the repo root by the user (a name-card/wordmark promo graphic, not a personal photo) but isn't wired into the current fully-typographic design.

Full design review completed and fixed once already: LatticeScene absolute-vs-fixed positioning bug, and missing --ls-h3/--ls-h4/--lh-body/--lh-h1/--lh-h2/--lh-h3 tokens in typography.css. Verified clean (build + Playwright, zero console errors) as of 2026-08-17.

Correction: this repo's project-scoped memory file lives at portfolio-website/.claude/memories/project_memory.json (cwd-relative), NOT at the parent Junecoderr/.claude/ one — a prior session edited the wrong file for many turns, which is why the cleanup hook kept re-firing. Always resolve the project_memory.json path relative to the current working directory.
Fixed. Home's lag was `HeroCipherField.jsx` (the decrypt-on-hover glyph grid) doing ~3,840 `fillText` calls a frame at 60fps, each rebuilding a fresh `rgba(...)` string via template literal — real GC
Fix the pre-loading screen, it's not upto the design, it has design flaws.
